name: Sudan
value: RSF drones hit Khartoum 22 Nov; 4 killed
summary: RSF drones kill four around Khartoum and damage a UN building on 22 Nov; fighting displaces thousands in Blue Nile
state: Drone attacks blamed on the RSF killed four people in Khartoum, Omdurman and Jebel Aulia on 22 Nov and damaged a UN building with staff inside, UN officials said (Al Jazeera). Sudan's government accused the RSF of executing captured soldiers in Blue Nile on 22 Nov, which is unverified; local groups say more than 51,000 people have been newly displaced in Blue Nile (Darfur24, 23 Nov). A UN report on 18 Nov said drones killed more than 1,630 civilians from January to October (The National). Continuing mass civilian deaths keep the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Kordofan, Blue Nile, Darfur and around Khartoum are most exposed to drone strikes and displacement. The FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Aid access and supply routes into neighbouring Chad, South Sudan and Egypt remain under strain.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass civilian deaths from drone and air strikes (UN: 1,630+ killed by drones Jan–Oct) and spreading displacement
